aestheticLimits: Faceted foliage, sparse track scenery and simple shading remain stylized/game-like, not photoreal beauty.
Dark side/front recesses and broad bonnet reflections limit fine surface readability.
Motion is established by wheel/scenery changes; lack of motion blur and modest camera escalation produce a restrained speed impression.
Engine and driver views are explanatory schematic cutaways, not verified engineering or lifelike performance.
